newsitem.title: JAPAN: China petrochem demand to top Japan's by 2000-MITI.
newsitem.headline: China petrochem demand to top Japan's by 2000-MITI.

text.p: China will have surpassed Japan in demand for ethylene-derived petrochemical products by 2000, while the Middle East is expected to catch up with Japan in output capacity, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Tuesday.

China's demand for petrochemical products manufactured from ethylene, such as polyethylene, styrene monomer and vinyl chloride monomer, will total eight million tonnes a year, calculated in terms of ethylene, in 2000, compared with 4.8 million tonnes in 1995, the ministry said in a report.
Demand in Japan, currently the largest in Asia, is expected to grow seven percent for the five-year period to 6.2 million tonnes, it said.
Demand in South Korea and India is expected to grow 50 percent to 4.2 and 1.8 million tonnes respectively over the same period.

As a result of the region's rapidly growing petrochemical appetite, Asia is expected to account for 33 percent of world demand for ethylene-derived products in 2000, compared with North America's 27 percent and western Europe's 23 percent, MITI said.
